headline: Godcrofts Leads Hectic Activity as War Remains Undecided
war_summary: The latest sheet shows a fresh burst of activity at Godcrofts, which has seen a dozen ownership changes in the last two hours and forty-two in the last day—the busiest log on the map. Fisherman's Row, the liveliest front in the previous edition, remains active, with eleven changes in six hours and twenty-nine in twenty-four, though the last two hours brought only two. Stonecradle has posted four changes in two hours and thirty-one in a day, with fighting cooling but enlistments still arriving. Mooring County also has three changes in the latest two-hour window, its six-hour and daily tallies both at six. Stlican Shelf and the Weathered Expanse, heavy in day-long totals of thirty-one and thirty-six, have had no ownership change in the latest six hours. Callahan's Passage and Linn Mercy show high casualty ledgers but slow change tables. After 233 days, neither side holds the thirty-four towns needed to end the war.
